name: thieves_den
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. A tall narrow ramshackle goblin thieves' hideout hut, clearly different from a lord's tent: crooked steep patched muted-purple cloth roof with a large hood/key symbol at apex, shuttered side window, reinforced little door and rope ladder, a sack by the foundation. Two close flat tones, no detailed grain, no perspective depth. Base rests firmly on ground.
